description: Structured-credit OAS solver configuration: paths, stochastic dimensions and seed.

credit_loading.description: Credit factor loading for the lognormal default/prepayment shocks.

hw1f_sigma.description:
Hull-White 1F short-rate volatility `σ`, absolute annual decimal
(`0.01` = 100 bp).

num_paths.description:
Number of Monte-Carlo scenarios (forced to 1 when neither dimension is
stochastic, since every scenario is then identical).

stochastic_credit.description: Couple a systematic stochastic-credit factor (correlated default/prepay stress).

stochastic_rates.description:
Couple a stochastic Hull-White short-rate path (rate paths + rate-dependent
prepayment, stochastic discounting).
